post.title: Egress Window Installation Monroe WA — Bedroom Escape Openings, Window Wells, Permits and Inspections
post.description: A Monroe guide to basement egress windows: when an escape opening is required, why cutting a foundation wall needs a City remodel permit, window wells, drainage, flashing, utility locates, inspections and hiring.

notes: Box-authored fallback. Home PC DESKTOP-B69F181 board-intake inbox had no 2026-11-16 packets at 3:47 AM PT (per parent); PC not touched. Topic: basement egress window installation in Monroe WA (Snohomish County). WAC 51-51-03100 (WA amended R310.1: basements, habitable attics, every sleeping room; each basement sleeping room; 36 in path; exceptions; R310.2.4 under decks 36x36, <=60 in; R310.5 not adopted). 2021 IRC R310 figures (5.7 sf, 5 sf grade floor, 24 in h, 20 in w, 44 in sill, well 9 sf / 36 in, ladder >44 in deep, 6 in encroachment, cover R310.4.4).
